name: active_inactive_v2
description: Decided 2026-10-11, replaces active_inactive_v1. Same Active / Inactive split for the behaviours kept, but pen-only behaviours and being mounted are excluded. Not comparable with active_resting_v1 or active_inactive_v1 (different classes or different windows).

reasons.BMN: Excluded. Being mounted: the cow is jolted by the mounting animal and it is an oestrus event, neither rest nor activity of the collared cow.
reasons.SLT: Excluded. Salt licking at a fixed lick block in the pen: absent from the extensive-pasture target, and seen in one cow only (cow3), so not learnable under leave-one-animal-out (0/24 correct in R5).
reasons.FES: Excluded. Feeding in a stancheon (head locked in a feeding rail): pen-only, absent from the extensive-pasture target, and seen in two cows only (cow1, cow5; 1/12 correct in R5).
reasons.DRN: Kept as Active, with grazing: drinking (head down, at a water point) also happens on pasture.
reasons.GRZ: Active: grazing is the main pasture activity and is recognised in every cow that grazes (24/24 in R5).
